items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: At the time you joined Duke, the 12 members of the band were ... Arthur Whetsel ... is that right? Right. Uh-huh.

ctx.x: No, it was just a new addition, a new funny sound. So, I was soloing from the beginning almost.

At the time you joined Duke, the 12 members of the band were Johnny Hodges, Barney Bigard, Harry Carney, Arthur Whetsel, Cootie Williams, Freddie Jenkins, Joe Nanton, Fred Guy, Wellman Braud, Sonny Greer, and Duke, is that right?
